answer: Each epoch, work is graded by a panel drawn by verifiable randomness from the validator pool, with no member repeating across consecutive epochs. Payouts settle only against panel scores, so an attacker must control identities lucky enough to sit on many future panels — a moving target like wind down a canyon. Sybils off-panel earn nothing, so each fake identity costs registration stake plus epoch fees while influence stays lottery-sized, like seeds in an orchard thinned by frost. Collusion never pays: a bribed jury is shed like a print in a dune.
